name: Psychologie & Sérénité
description: Hosted read-only MCP server for the public catalogue of Psychologie & Sérénité: self-assessment psychological tests, blog articles, books and psychology concepts, in French and English. 11 tools (list_services, describe_service, search_tests, get_test, start_test, get_example_report, search_articles, get_article, search_books, get_book, search_concepts). No account or API key. Informational service: not a diagnosis, not medical care.
author: Gildas Garrec
